records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one independent transparent game container sprite for a cozy luggage-organizing puzzle. Primary request: a single EMPTY OPEN suitcase compartment viewed nearly front-on from slightly above, shallow depth, broad horizontal rounded rectangle, interior fills most of silhouette, no upright lid, handle below, small hinges and leather trim. Match a polished softly outlined hand-painted storybook game illustration, warm light from upper left, simple clean shading, crisp readable shape. Warm caramel-brown leather exterior shell with warm honey-tan fabric lining and a soft stitched rim. It is ONE container only, centered, width about twice height, full silhouette visible and generous transparent margin. Interior is empty, flat and unobstructed so game code can overlay two horizontal placement cells. No contents, no book, no letters, no A/B/C labels, no numbers, no grid, no UI buttons, no arrows, no scenery, no floor shadow, no frame, no collage, no watermark. True RGBA transparent background. This is retainable AI game-art candidate for P1-01R, not final art approval. Match the attached independently generated container's drawing language and viewpoint; the attached image is a production style reference, not a collage to crop.
